verdict.rationale: Speed benchmarks are a fair question for a package manager, so the axis applies. The pack has no published benchmarks or measured performance numbers from Nix. The closest material is binary-cache feature claims and community anecdotes (e.g. 'saves our entire dev team hours', 'faster than juggling Docker containers'), which are unquantified opinions, not measurements.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see published benchmarks or measured numbers backing the manager's speed claims
